Root reviews each whole derived passage against the source for omissions, residual OCR damage, names/numbers/negations, speaker/quotation boundaries, accidental neighbor inclusion and truncated endings. Unchecked passages remain ungraded, not passed.
Assess reading flow and pronunciation-relevant text separately from exact fidelity. Preserve historical spelling/grammar; no synthesized speech or listening claim.
